items.text: Micromanagement nightmare. You have to control your dumb sim's every move, from putting his grubby shoes on to taking a ♥♥♥♥ (or else he bursts, or what?). Piloting your vessel is even worse. The game is set in 2079, while the first real-world autopilot was already invented in 1914 btw.
items.text_zh: 微观管理噩梦。你必须控制你那愚蠢的小人的每一个动作，从穿上他那脏兮兮的鞋子到拉♥♥♥♥（不然他会爆掉，还是怎样？）。驾驶你的飞船就更糟了。游戏设定在2079年，而现实世界中第一个自动驾驶仪早在1914年就已经发明了，顺便说一句。
